study_note: Three-seed, 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk ablation against the official-style TD-MPC2 state baseline. The only scientific hyperparameter change is num_pi_trajs=512 instead of 24 while num_samples remains 512, so every MPPI candidate trajectory originates from the learned stochastic policy. All other model, optimizer, replay, planning, training, and evaluation settings match configs/dmcontrol/algs/tdmpc2_humanoid_walk_state.json. The W&B group and tags are distinct experiment metadata.
